text: Bitcoin's modest 1.1% gain with rising dominance (58.7%) suggests strength in the largest asset, while Ethereum's slower 0.4% climb indicates investors are favoring BTC over altcoins. The Fear & Greed index at 74 paired with a $98B trading volume reflects sustained confidence, though the disparity between BTC and ETH gains hints at appetite concentrating at the market top rather than broad bullish conviction.
